mapper.sql: select o.order_id, o.order_no, o.wx_user_id, o.openid, o.total_amount, o.pay_type, o.pay_status, o.pay_no, o.pay_time, o.order_status, o.pickup_date, o.pickup_no, o.pickup_code, o.verify_time, o.verify_by, o.finish_time, o.customer_remark, o.cancel_reason, o.del_flag, o.create_by, o.create_time, o.update_by, o.update_time, o.remark, u.nick_name, u.phone from shop_order o left join wx_user u on o.wx_user_id = u.wx_user_id
mapper.select: select ifnull(max(pickup_no), 0) from shop_order where pickup_date = #{pickupDate}
where o.del_flag = '0' and ( (o.order_status in ('1', '2', '3') and o.pay_status = '1') or (o.order_status = '0' and o.pay_type = '1') ) order by o.create_time
where o.pickup_code = #{pickupCode} and o.del_flag = '0' and o.pickup_date = curdate()
mapper.insert: insert into shop_order( order_no, wx_user_id, openid, total_amount, pay_type, pay_status, order_status, pickup_date, pickup_no, pickup_code, customer_remark, del_flag, create_by, create_time )values( #{orderNo}, #{wxUserId}, #{openid}, #{totalAmount}, #{payType}, #{payStatus}, #{orderStatus}, #{pickupDate}, #{pickupNo}, #{pickupCode}, #{customerRemark}, '0', #{createBy}, sysdate() )
mapper.update: update shop_order set order_status = #{orderStatus}, update_time = sysdate() where order_id = #{orderId}
update shop_order set order_status = '5', cancel_reason = #{cancelReason}, update_time = sysdate() where order_id = #{orderId} and order_status in ('0', '1')
update shop_order set order_status = '4', finish_time = sysdate(), update_time = sysdate() where order_id = #{orderId}
mapper.delete: update shop_order set del_flag = '2', update_time = sysdate() where order_id = #{orderId}
